data.one_liner: Routing for linear wizards with central route definitions and no page dependencies.
data.what_it_does: Provides linear wizard routing that eliminates tight coupling between individual wizard pages. Pages can request the next or previous step without knowing what comes before or after them, while routes and transition conditions are defined centrally.
use_when: You are building a multi-step wizard or onboarding flow
You want to decouple wizard pages so they don't depend on each other's order
avoid_when: You need complex non-linear navigation graphs or standard application routing
strengths: Supports conditional step skipping and passing arguments

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose declarative router for full application navigation and deep linking.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer code-generation-based routing with strong typing for complex navigation.
